content: Modern real-time continuous glucose monitoring (rtCGM) devices have significantly reduced the need for frequent manual calibration, which was previously a major challenge for users. This improvement has enhanced the overall convenience and ease of use for individuals relying on these systems. Some advanced rtCGM systems are equipped with auto-calibration features, eliminating the need for user intervention in this process. Additionally, these systems can integrate seamlessly with insulin pumps, enabling automated insulin delivery based on real-time glucose readings. This integration allows for more precise and timely adjustments in insulin administration. These advancements have proven to be highly beneficial for both adults and children managing diabetes. By reducing the reliance on manual blood glucose testing, these systems alleviate the burden of frequent finger-prick tests and provide a more dynamic and responsive approach to diabetes management.
